Subject: Re: Incidents this month — next steps and ask

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the quick response after Wednesday's latency spike. We appreciate the postmortem and the mitigation work you pushed. That said, the variability has put our fraud detection pipelines at risk during peak windows and Procurement is asking for a concrete commercial remediation before renewal.

Specifically we need:
- A path to guaranteed regional redundancy across two AZs or an accepted credit schedule if you can’t deliver by contract renewal.
- A proposal for a Dedicated onramp / reserved capacity pilot and timing.
- Any temporary service credits for the recent incidents.

Can we get a formal proposal and SOW by next Friday (Aug 6)? Procurement needs this to brief the CFO.

Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Operations
BlueHaven Bank

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and appreciate the urgency. I wanted to acknowledge receipt and outline what we’ll deliver by Aug 6: an actionable remediation package with two parallel tracks — (1) a redundancy/credit ladder and (2) an accelerated Dedicated onramp SOW + pricing.

Plan (high level):
- Redundancy credit ladder: tiered credits tied to cross-AZ failover objectives and tail-latency windows; immediate temporary bridge credit for the July disruptions.
- Dedicated onramp: 8-week pilot scope, expected start within 2–3 weeks subject to signature, includes capacity reservation, pre-warming, and a runbook for failover testing.
- Technical deliverable: detailed cutover and validation checklist from our infra team (Sergio) and an timelines map for adding AZ redundancy.

I’ll attach the draft proposal (see proposal v1) and Sergio will follow up on the runbook and validation timeline. If this looks aligned, we’ll finalize the SOW and pricing and aim to get you a DocuSign link by Aug 6.

Elena / Vanessa —

Following up with the technical playbook we’ll include in the SOW:
- Cross-AZ redundancy: we can deploy a hot-standby routing policy in the target region within 3–4 weeks of pilot start; full automated failover exercises in week 6.
- Quantifiable metrics: target P99 tail latency reduction by 30% during peak windows based on the pilot config (we’ll baseline week 0).
- Failover test plan: three staged tests (dry-run, scheduled failover, emergency failover) with rollback steps.

Temporary commercial remedy: we propose a 6% service credit applied to July invoice and an accelerated credit ladder if incidents repeat during the following 30 days. That’s written into the attached proposal.

Open items for procurement/legal: final pricing for Dedicated nodes (listed in SOW), and the duration of the pilot commitment. Karhtik — can you confirm pricing floor for a 3-month reserved pilot?
